transitions: OFFLINE_READY -> LIVE_APPROVED after the single owner gate, exact-target preflight, clean approved commit/tree, lock acquisition and first activation-hash recomputation all pass
LIVE_APPROVED -> FAILED_PARTIAL on the first error after any provider or tenant write
LIVE_APPROVED -> PASSED only after all twelve steps and final invariants pass
FAILED_PARTIAL is terminal for the MVP and requires human review plus a new run only after provider-specific read-only reconciliation exists
